description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 99. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. The page file is written by hand. A block hash must be 0x followed by 64 lower case hex digits (clause 7), the form the escrow rules read too. The EscrowOpened at block 7 with a valid hash counts. A second copy of it with the same hash written in upper case (0xA1...) is malformed, so it neither counts nor dedupes with the first. An EscrowOpened by synthetic-bob with the short hash 0xabc is malformed. An EscrowReleased with a valid hash at block 9 counts. Expected: complete true, status complete; covered 0 to 99; gaps none; totals escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 2; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1).
